title: processBlock wiring — lookahead, stereo, anomaly, rejected, CMakeLists
description:
Be the sole PluginProcessor + CMakeLists.txt owner for phase G. Wire LookaheadDelay, StereoLinker, AnomalyGuard, and RejectedSignalRouter into prepare/processBlock; call setLatencySamples for exact main-path delay; register new DSP sources and stereo/lookahead tests.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp existing phase F signal order (key → delay → detector → guards → state → gain → multiband/topology)
- Source/DSP/LookaheadDelay.*, StereoLinker.*, AnomalyGuard.*, RejectedSignalRouter.* public APIs from g.1–g.3
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §3 signal flow (Optional Main Lookahead, Stereo Link Matrix), §17–19, §20.5, latency rules (default 0, exact PDC when lookahead on)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for global.lookahead, stereo.linkMode/linkAmount, audition.rejectedMode/stateFilterMode, key.fallbackMode
- Existing CMakeLists.txt target_sources / test registration from prior phases

PluginProcessor wiring (realtime-safe):
- Members: LookaheadDelay, StereoLinker, AnomalyGuard, RejectedSignalRouter plus any small audition output buffer. Preallocate temps in prepare only.
- Conceptual processBlock order extension:
  1) existing key selection/conditioning (+ FractionalDelay key-path if present)
  2) AnomalyGuard: spike on main/key as appropriate → suppress false opens into AttackGuard/state path; stuck-key from external key vs main energy; dropout → hold then switch to internal detection when fallback enabled
  3) Detector envelopes: feed StereoLinker for Max/Energy/Average/DualMono + link amount before shared state/gain decisions on stereo buses; DualMono may run independent L/R gains if already supported, else document single-envelope + gain-link path
  4) existing state machine → gain → multiband/topology path producing wet y from dry x
  5) LookaheadDelay on the MAIN wet (or dry-before-gate if closing early requires delayed dry—prefer delaying the path that must align openings: delay dry main into gate application so attack aligns; document). Combine lookahead samples with any main-path alignment delay already counted.
  6) RejectedSignalRouter: r = x−y (and band rejects if multiband taps available); when audition mode ≠ Off, route audition to output or replace monitoring path per listen/audition param without breaking dry/wet engaged processing—if host has single out, optional swap-to-audition when mode on
  7) setLatencySamples(LookaheadDelay.getLatencySamples() + any residual main-path alignment delay); default Off → 0. No hidden latency.
- prepareToPlay: prepare all phase-G units; reset on releaseResources as needed.
- Read APVTS via ParameterIDs when present; else safe defaults. No editor/GUI work.

CMakeLists.txt (phase-G sole owner):
- Add LookaheadDelay.cpp, StereoLinker.cpp, AnomalyGuard.cpp, RejectedSignalRouter.cpp to plugin/library target_sources
- Register tests/LookaheadTests.cpp and tests/StereoTests.cpp on the existing test executable/target (bodies filled in g.5)
- Additive only — do not restructure unrelated targets

Do NOT implement test bodies (g.5). Do NOT rewrite DSP unit sources owned by g.1–g.3.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginProcessor.h/.cpp construct and prepare LookaheadDelay, StereoLinker, AnomalyGuard, and RejectedSignalRouter
processBlock applies StereoLinker modes and link amount on stereo envelope/gain paths
AnomalyGuard spike/stuck-key/dropout results influence open-suppression and key fallback as documented
LookaheadDelay is applied on the main path and AudioProcessor::setLatencySamples reports exact main-path delay (0 when lookahead off)
RejectedSignalRouter can produce r[n]=x[n]-y[n] audition when audition mode is enabled
CMakeLists.txt lists LookaheadDelay.cpp, StereoLinker.cpp, AnomalyGuard.cpp, and RejectedSignalRouter.cpp
CMakeLists.txt registers tests/LookaheadTests.cpp and tests/StereoTests.cpp on the test target
No heap allocation introduced on the audio path after prepareToPlay
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: add member instances and includes for phase G DSP units on PluginProcessor
combine lookahead latency with existing main-path alignment delay when both engaged
read existing APVTS parameters by ParameterIDs when available, else temporary defaults
add CMake target_sources for phase G DSP units and LookaheadTests/StereoTests
when DualMono full dual state machines are not present, link gains after a shared state machine and document the limitation
forbidden: reimplement circular delay, link formulas, spike/stuck/dropout logic, or r[n] math inside PluginProcessor beyond API calls
expand scope into Performance Timeline / Diagnose GUI panels
report non-zero latency when lookahead is Off and no main-path alignment delay is active
